grown.scope: The same 480 durable mappings and 240 documents before and after; no leaf removal.

protocol.freeze: Created before implementing or running a new matching algorithm.
protocol.routing_inputs: Only task text and registered triggers; never required paths.
protocol.positive_hit: Every required document is returned with its complete body before action.
protocol.extras: Record unexpected returned documents separately; do not hide overmatching.
protocol.before: Release startup delivery and explicit open(task, limit=3), reported separately.
protocol.after: Task-aware managed surface with the same source corpus and frozen cases.
protocol.cost: Whole StartupReader.context and rendered index measured independently with o200k_base.
protocol.limits: This is a small lexical fixture, not general agent-compliance or billing evidence.
